PairedDevice.title: PairedDevice
PairedDevice.description: A controller phone or receiver tablet registered under a user's Google account for automatic Wi-Fi discovery and accessibility-backed control.

role.description: Whether the device acts as a remote controller or tablet receiver.

localIp.description: Current local Wi-Fi IPv4 address for direct low-latency socket connection.

port.description: TCP socket listening port on receiver devices.

sessionToken.description: Per-device token used to authenticate local Wi-Fi control sessions.

isOnline.description: True when the receiver/controller is actively reachable.

accessibilityReady.description: True when the tablet Accessibility Service & cursor overlay are enabled.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Devices belonging to the signed-in Google user for seamless phone-to-tablet discovery.
